para.dtcname: Line Pressure Control Linear SOL Circuit

content5.ptxt: Based on the signals from the accelerator position sensor and transmission revolution sensors, the transmission control computer controls the line pressure control solenoid assembly (SLT) to a predetermined duty ratio. As a result, the line pressure is regulated to a pressure that matches the throttle opening angle and engine output.

The transmission control computer calculates the heat generated by the friction material from the speeds of the transmission revolution sensors (NT and NC), and detects slipping of the clutches, etc. As a fail-safe, the operation of the throttle motor is limited and shifting to 5 and 6 is prohibited on the 2 trip.

atten3.ptxt: DTC P2714/77 indicates that the solenoid (SLT) is [stuck ON (malfunction)]. If the solenoid (SLT) remains ON, the line pressure and clutch pressure drop, which may cause the friction material to burn and the vehicle to become undrivable.

entry.ptxt: 1. Detection condition 2. Malfunction status 3. Malfunction duration 4. Other

item.ptxt: ATF temperature is -10°C or higher and the vehicle is being driven in D range (however, no malfunction is detected in SL1, SL2, SL3, SL4 solenoids, transmission revolution sensors (NT and NC) or fluid temperature sensor)
In any gear position, the transmission revolution sensor (NC) speed is lower than normal relative to the transmission revolution sensor (NT) speed

test1.ptxt: Using SST (TaSCAN), follow the prompts on the screen to display the [Diagnosis Menu/ECT] screen, and select [DTC Freeze Data].
Check the DTCs and freeze data.

entry.ptxt: P2714/77 and other DTCs are output

item.ptxt: If any DTCs other than solenoid and hydraulic pressure switch malfunctions are output, troubleshoot those DTCs first.
If only multiple solenoid malfunction codes are output, inspect the solenoids corresponding to the output DTCs at the same time.

testgrp.testtitle: Perform TaSCAN Active Test (Line Pressure Solenoid)

atten3.ptxt: Before and after measurement, clean the gauges and hoses with white gasoline or equivalent.

test1.ptxt: Remove the test plug, install the automatic transmission oil pressure gauge and adapter C, and start the engine.
Using SST (TaSCAN), follow the prompts on the screen to display the [Active Test] screen, and perform the Active Test of the line pressure control solenoid assembly (SLT).

table.title: [Diagnosis menu screen: Powertrain → ECT → Active Test]

entry.ptxt: Solenoid SLT current can be switched MIN ←→ MAX
The test can be performed in P or N range with the throttle fully closed (at idle) and vehicle speed 0km/h

test1.ptxt: Check the gauge reading and inspect the change in line pressure.
Replace the transmission control computer assembly. (see )

testgrp.testtitle: Inspect Line Pressure Control Solenoid Assembly (SLT)

test1.ptxt: Connect the battery positive to terminal 2 and the battery negative to terminal 1 of the line pressure control solenoid assembly (SLT) via a 12V-21W bulb, and check that the valve in the solenoid operates.
Using SST (Toyota electrical tester), check the resistance between the terminals.
